title: himantoglossum hircinum subsp. calcaratum
intro: Himantoglossum hircinum subsp. calcaratum, commonly known as the calcarate orchid, is a plant species in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include its potential to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Himantoglossum hircinum subsp. calcaratum include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
